decision: dsfd_sp_ctrl engine ports + ot_s81_engine_adapter are THE command/start/done interface of every S81 slab; retire only hop_tx (ot_s81_hop_tx / --ctrl-slab handoff); keep ot_s81_stage_seq + engine adapters. WFC kit = single stage controller (mtp-wfc-1010 owns kit<->stage_seq).

ports.cv: output [11:0] one-cycle command pulse per engine (no ready: credit-governed)
ports.dv: input [11:0] one-cycle done pulse per engine

command_word.tag: {slot, op} = {cmd[83], cmd[6:0]} (8 bits): the done tag must echo it
command_word.source: rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ctrl/ot_s81_stage_seq.sv cmd_d packing; op = program entry index, arg = compiler-owned native descriptor (tools/s81_ctrl/native_descriptors.py, native_registry.json)

adapter.placement: inside each slab master at the slab boundary (engine clock e_clk = the slab clock); the die nets between dsfd_sp_ctrl and the slab carry only c_cmd_v/c_cmd_d (85 b) and c_done_v/c_done_tag (9 b) pulses

engine_side.e_cmd_ready: <- engine can accept a descriptor this cycle
engine_side.e_inputs_present: <- engine operands for the head descriptor are present (VM row-completion counter / landing FIFO non-empty); gates issue
engine_side.e_done_v: <- engine REAL completion (last result beat committed, never a constant)

adapter.handshake: controller: QD=8 credits per engine, one credit returned only by a validated done (no ready on the die net). Adapter: depth-8 pulse CDC queue each way (ot_s81_pulse_cdc over ot_async_fifo); engine side is valid/ready on e_cmd, pulse on e_done. Faults: command without credit, duplicate pending tag, done for a non-pending tag.

latency.cmd_issue_to_e_cmd_v: async FIFO: ~2 synchroniser + 2 register cycles of e_clk (+ die relay stations on cv/cd: fixed, priced per hop by the generator) + 1 output register (2026-10-11 timing fix)
latency.e_done_to_dv: ~2 sync + 2 register cycles of c_clk (+ relay stations) + 1 output register (2026-10-11 timing fix)
latency.priced_in: tools/s81_ctrl/die_binding_contract.py model: stage_handoff_extra_cycles 3, ar_stage_handoffs 121; generator must add the relay-station count per engine net

adapter.transport: cv/cd/dv/dt are pulse nets with no back-pressure: die relay stations are plain pipeline flops (fixed latency), allowed on any hop; every die input/output lands in a pin flop

fld.start: sp_gather (VM operand read + field broadcast of the phase)
fld.done: sp_capture (last captured row of the phase committed to the VM write port)

su.done: SU result written back to VM

hc.start: HC slab master (s81-suhc-1011); hc_input_capture schema in tools/s81_ctrl/native_registry.json

hop.start: RETIRED: ot_s81_hop_tx / pkg_ctrl handoff removed (decision 10-10 22:02); the stage hand-off rides the collective slab ctrl lanes (ot_s81_ctrl_lane_adapter, dsfd_sp_collective_ctrl)

slab: WFC kit (dsfd_wfc_cr2) if bound by mtp-wfc-1010, else UNUSED (gate must see no descriptor routed here)

die_gate.rule: die_port_audit (generator): FAIL if any functional slab or dsfd_sp_ctrl port is tied off, constant, or unconnected; per-slab report; ck/rs bound to the streaming clock/reset trees. The binding manifest validates via tools/s81_ctrl/die_binding_contract.py --validate (qualification NATIVE_BINDING_READY only when every engine has a pinned adapter and a real endpoint).

bench.rule: die bench drives programs through dsfd_sp_ctrl pw_* / i_* (no host-driven stand-ins); checks done ordering and slab outputs vs golden; mutants: dropped done, early start (ignore e_inputs_present), wrong done tag -> FAIL (adapter MUT=1/2 exist for payload / tag)

consumers: s81-ctl-1011 (fld/coll/sel/svc/col binding, generator, gate, die bench)
s81-vm-1011 (VM master: e_inputs_present from the row-completion counter; dsfd_sp_ctrl VM port vwe/vwa/vwd/vre/vra/vrq/vrv with vm_read_cycles == 1)
status: v1 PROPOSED: slab-to-engine mapping for capture/gather (fld) to be confirmed by s81-ctl-1011 against the generator buses
